Quire note: paginator.js has two small changes (attributes turn-duration and turn-ease). Everything else is unmodified foliate-js.

- comic-book.js: picture names are matched without regard to case, so PAGE01.JPG counts as a page.
- epub.js: the series expression is parenthesised; without it an EPUB 3 series was replaced by the (missing) Calibre one.
